programmes.d: A Texas marshal (James Stewart) and a cavalry officer (Richard Widmark) recover long-held captives from Comanches.
A cowgirl vigilante (Wanda Hendrix) proves to a deputy (Lon McCallister) that the sheriff (Preston Foster) is an outlaw.
The scout's grandson (Bill Elliott) foils land-grabbers; his sidekick (Dub Taylor) flirts with twins.
The inhabitants of a small western community turn on Jim Guthrie (Dana Andrews) when he becomes the prime suspect for a murder he didn't commit.
A circa-1917 rancher sends mercenaries (Lee Marvin, Burt Lancaster) to rescue his kidnapped wife (Claudia Cardinale) from a Mexican bandit.
Two old-time Wyoming fur trappers (Charlton Heston, Brian Keith) try to protect a runaway Indian (Victoria Racimo) from her angry ex-mate.
A practical-joking cowboy (Buck Jones) gets serious with outlaws.
A rancher (Tim McCoy) and his buddy (Joseph Sauers) scare rustlers out of business.
Wild Bill Hickok (Bill Elliott) puts on a badge to clean up a town.
A lone cowboy (Ken Maynard) gets the bad guys and wins the gal (Beth Marion).
A rugged rancher (Van Heflin) with good and bad sons can only stop his bad son (Tab Hunter) with a gun.
Tim thinks saloon owner Coldeye killed his brother. Seeking the ultimate payback, Tim gets a job in the saloon but has no idea he is targeting the wrong man.
A preacher (Van Heflin) with a reckless past rebuilds a church after the Civil War with a teenage girl (Joanne Woodward) from the hills.
A man whose life was saved by an outlaw shows his gratitude by reluctantly assisting in a stagecoach robbery.
